125580.overview:
You are the legendary Red Baron, flying a plane through a horizontal side-scrolling scenery set during World War I. To complete a mission, you simply need to get to the landing spot on the other side without being shot down, but you can gain extra points by destroying enemy vehicles and planes. For huge points, pick up a bomb hidden in the level (you will be warned by a sound when approaching it) and drop it on a large structure. If you fail to land on the landing strip, you run out of fuel and crash.

You can only shoot horizontally and diagonally by tilting the plane's nose. When in trouble, perform an aerial loop with the secondary button, this often destroys other planes and avoids bullets. There is a co-op mode with the character Max as well.

125581.overview: A 3D course with simple graphics like thin blue sleepers lined up in outer space, and spacecraft race on an inexhaustible course (16 faces in total) like a roller coaster. In addition to enemy planes, foreign objects called fantasy graphics may enter the course. Starts are individual rather than simultaneous, competing for running time. The time of the enemy aircraft is set in advance, and if you are in the 3rd place, you can proceed to the next race.

125582.overview: Super Baseball has a relatively orthodox system for an early baseball game, and the basic operation method is not much different from that of subsequent family stadiums (there are also changing balls and ball speed adjustments). It has some pioneering features as a baseball game of the pre-Family era.

125583.overview: The course has 18 holes and a total length of 5,805 meters. You have to get the ball into the hole with a minimum of strokes, despite the wind and many obstacles. You can choose the club, the direction and the force with which the ball will be sent. Challenge your friends, one to four people can play together.

126183.overview: Find yourself facing your opponents on a football stadium! You can dribble, pass, shoot, or send the ball with your head. You can control the trajectory of the ball and the length of each pass. You can also shoot corners, free kicks and penalties. For one or two players.

126368.overview: Arithmetic learning software for kindergarten children to sixth graders .

126369.overview: The objective of the game is to take the opposing king. When the king cannot avoid being caught on the next move, the game is over. They say the king is "Matt". The shogi opposes two players who take turns playing. The Shogi chess board is called Shogi Ban ("Shogi table") and has 81 squares (9 x 9), the three rows furthest from the players constituting their promotion area. At the start of the game each player has 20 pieces: a king, a rook, a bishop, two gold generals, two silver generals, two horsemen, two spears, and nine pawns.

133384.overview: Super Mahjong is a 1v1 mahjong game for one player.
